old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-mhoo","title":"Python sends peer-specific unfragmented SCHC as link broadcast","description":"Security review: Node._transmit_peer_schc() accepts a concrete next-hop PeerIdentity, but for packets \u003c= MAX_SINGLE_FRAME_SCHC_PACKET it calls link.send(wrap_schc_payload(schc)) with default AddrMode.NONE instead of the peer canonical EUI-64/Extended mode. Every neighbor therefore authenticates and processes a packet compressed under one peer policy; this leaks unicast traffic, consumes replay/receipt work on non-targets, and contradicts the fragmented path, which correctly uses Extended. Send all peer-policy traffic to iid_to_eui64(peer.iid) with AddrMode.EXTENDED and add an exact wire-destination test for both single-frame and fragmented branches.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:32:55.068582Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:32:55.068582Z"}
